note: Bart 11-10: forest floor too flat and fake, needs more green grass; the ground layers make a scene work. Floor redrawn green (same asset id, replaces v1) + two ground strips like meadow-band-01 / ground-heath-01.

sheets.subject: Sunlit woodland clearing floor: mostly fresh green short grass and soft moss cushions, broken by irregular patches of brown leaf litter and bare earth, a few small clover and herb leaves, uneven so it never reads as a pattern; seamless on both axes.

(1) a deep strip of woodland clearing ground running far into the distance: lush green grass and moss with patches of brown leaf litter, small ferns, tufts of wood grass, low herbs with tiny white and yellow flowers, a mossy root and a few small mossy stones, the grass tops forming a soft ragged far edge; (2) a shallow near strip of woodland verge: tall green grass tufts, moss, a few low ferns and fallen leaves, seen close.
